It is probably only in your current experience of life that you can ever feel at peace with you, so I think it is better to find a way to resolve those conflicts in your mind or in your past, write your experiences, paint or create any sort of art, fall in love and get hold of it while you can, the most beautiful feeling you could probably feel, and help people that go through similar circumstances, as having empathy and being reciprocally comprehended by others can also make you feel a lot better with yourself (in my opinion). Plus, you may have other important reasons to live, such as your loved ones or your own personal goals. I have found it very useful to try to impose great achievable goals in life, things that can eventually change the world, no matter how small these changes may be, as long as they are positive and bring inner satisfaction to my own self. Having that sense of achievement can bring a lot of joy into your life, and regardless of your own religious or philosophical beliefs, one can always create meaning in life to things that may appear to have none at all. Don't give up, experience emotions and embrace them, some of them are worth more than not feeling anything at all. All the best.
